# KI-137 — `khala local` CLI and helper composition

**Lane:** helper · **Complexity:** 2 · **Model:** codex · **Depends on:** KI-122, KI-130, KI-131, KI-132, KI-133, KI-134, KI-135, KI-136 · **Serializes with:** none
**Plan context (pinned):** [plan](../../../plans/2026-10-02-001-feat-internal-mode-plan.md) · [contracts](../contracts.md) · [roster and graph](../roster.md) · researched at `5ad41c8b`
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `packages/agent/src/local/serve.ts`, `packages/agent/src/local/serve.test.ts`, `packages/agent/src/local/cli.ts`, `packages/agent/src/local/cli.test.ts`, `packages/agent/bin/khala.mjs`, `packages/agent/src/bin.test.ts`

## Outcome

`khala local …` works from any shell (an agent's Bash tool or the human's terminal):

- `khala local serve` composes the real helper: the channel store (KI-130) at `<stateRoot>/local`, the owner profile bootstrapped from the local owner name (KI-122), a fresh admin token, the HTTP core (KI-131) with every route module (KI-132..KI-135), and `helper.json` written atomically after the port is bound. It exits 0 on idle, `SIGTERM`/`SIGINT` or `POST /api/local/shutdown`, removing `helper.json`; it exits 0 immediately when another healthy helper already owns the port.
- `khala local create|link|open|list|delete|status|stop` print exactly one JSON object (L12), starting the helper on demand through `ensureHelper` (KI-136) and calling the L6 owner routes with the admin bearer. Nothing ever launches a browser.

Operator-visible: AE1 (Claude runs `khala local create refactor` and gets `selfLink`, `shareLink`, `openUrl` on `http://127.0.0.1:47830`; the helper was started if absent), AE8 (restart), AE12 (`khala local delete`). This is the composition point named in the plan's integration ledger ("Route modules (KI-132..135) ↔ store (KI-130) and server (KI-131): KI-137 composes them"; "Owner name (KI-122) ↔ helper first start (KI-137)").

## Context and evidence

- **D2** (on-demand loopback helper, auto-started, idle exit, never a service), **D5** (single-use links), **D8** (owner name from the cached hosted username else `$USER`), P1 (owner cookie only via `/open/<token>`), P2 (two links at create), P4 (`503 web_not_built` → the CLI tells the user the build command), P6 (no human chat CLI).
- KTD7: "`khala local` is a subcommand of the existing bin (`packages/agent/bin/khala.mjs`), plain `node:http`/`node:crypto`/`node:fs`, zero new dependencies."
- research-2 §8 operator flow (agent runs `khala local create "X"` through its shell, then `khala_join(selfLink)`).

## Scope

1. `serve.ts`: `runHelper(options)` — composition, `HelperContext`, auth callbacks, bind/`EADDRINUSE`, `helper.json`, shutdown.
2. `cli.ts`: `runLocalCommand(argv, deps)` implementing the L12 table, and the default export used by the bin.
3. `bin/khala.mjs`: `local` dispatch and the usage line; `src/bin.test.ts` updated.
4. `serve.test.ts`, `cli.test.ts` (unit + one in-process integration test + one spawned-binary smoke test).

- Route behaviour (validation, status codes, naming, announcements, `/open/<token>` cookie response, `/api/local/shutdown` route itself): **KI-132**, **KI-133**, **KI-134**, **KI-135**. This ticket only wires them and supplies the context hooks they call.
- Store semantics: **KI-130**. HTTP guards and static serving: **KI-131**. Spawning and health-waiting: **KI-136**. Owner-name resolution: **KI-122**.
- Agent skill text and install docs (`khala local create` usage for agents): **KI-150**.
- The scripted end-to-end run with real agents and a browser: **KI-160**; the no-egress guard: **KI-151**.
- Building `dist-local`: **KI-143**.

## Contract and invariants

Contracts L12, verbatim:

> Every command prints exactly one JSON object on stdout and exits 0, or prints `{"error":<code>}` on stdout and exits 1. Commands that need the helper call `ensureHelper` first.
>
> | Command | Output |
> |---|---|
> | `khala local create [name]` | `LocalChannelCreated` (L6). Default name `local-<yyyy-mm-dd>` |
> | `khala local link <roomId\|name>` | `{ shareLink, expiresAt }` |
> | `khala local open [roomId\|name]` | `{ openUrl, expiresAt }` (never launches a browser) |
> | `khala local list` | `{ channels: LocalChannelSummary[] }` |
> | `khala local delete <roomId\|name>` | `{ deleted: roomId }` |
> | `khala local status` | `{ running: boolean, origin?, pid?, version?, channels?: number }` (does not start the helper) |
> | `khala local stop` | `{ stopped: boolean }` |
> | `khala local serve` | runs the helper in the foreground (used by `ensureHelper`; prints nothing on success) |
>
> A name argument matches a channel by exact name; an ambiguous name → `{"error":"ambiguous_channel"}`.

Contracts L11, verbatim (the parts this ticket implements in `serve`):

```ts
export type HelperFile = { v: 1; pid: number; port: number; origin: string; adminToken: string; version: string; startedAt: string };
```
> - Binds `127.0.0.1` only, port `KHALA_LOCAL_PORT` or `LOCAL_DEFAULT_PORT` (47830). `EADDRINUSE`: if `GET /healthz` on that port answers `{ok:true}` the new process exits 0 (another helper owns it); otherwise it fails with `port_in_use` (no silent port move: links embed the port).
> - **Owner cookie:** `khala_local_owner=<43-char random>`; `HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/`; no `Secure` (plain loopback). Session ids live in memory; a helper restart signs the browser out until `khala local open` mints a new open link. `/open/<token>` is the only way to obtain the cookie.
> - **Idle exit (D2):** the helper exits 0 after `KHALA_LOCAL_IDLE_MS` (default `LOCAL_IDLE_EXIT_MS`) with no request and no open long-poll. It is never installed as a service.
> - **Static web app:** `GET` of any non-`/api/`, non-`/open/`, non-`/healthz` path serves `apps/web/dist-local/` (env override `KHALA_LOCAL_WEB_DIR`), with SPA fallback to `index.html`; assets get `cache-control: no-cache`. A missing build answers `503 {"error":"web_not_built"}` and the CLI tells the user to run `pnpm --filter @khala/web build:local`.

Contracts L6, verbatim (the routes the CLI calls; all with `Authorization: Bearer <adminToken>`):

```ts
// GET    /api/local/channels?since=<revision>&wait=<0..25>    → LocalChannelsPage   newest activity first
export type LocalChannelsPage = { revision: number; channels: LocalChannelSummary[] };   // revision: helper-wide counter bumped on every append/create/delete (in memory; restarts at 0)
// POST   /api/local/channels           body {name, operationId?} → LocalChannelCreated   (name 1..64 chars, trimmed; appends create + owner join; operationId 1..64 [A-Za-z0-9._-] is stored in the create content and is idempotent)
export type LocalChannelCreated = { roomId: string; name: string; selfLink: string; shareLink: string; openUrl: string; expiresAt: string };
// DELETE /api/local/channels/:roomId                          → 204   (removes the channel directory; open long-polls end with 404)
// POST   /api/local/channels/:roomId/links                    → { shareLink: string; expiresAt: string }   a fresh single-use join link
// POST   /api/local/open            body {roomId?}             → { openUrl: string; expiresAt: string }   (admin bearer only)
// GET    /open/<43-char token>                                → 302 to /channels/<encodeURIComponent(roomId)> or /channels; sets the owner cookie; single use
// GET    /healthz                                             → { ok: true, version: string, pid: number }   (no auth, no data)
// POST   /api/local/shutdown                                  → 204   (admin bearer only)
```

Contracts L8 `HelperContext`, verbatim (this ticket constructs it):

```ts
export type HelperContext = { store: LocalStore; origin: string; now(): number; random(bytes: number): Uint8Array; version: string;
  mintOpenToken(roomId?: string): { token: string; expiresAt: string }; consumeOpenToken(token: string): { roomId?: string } | null;   // in memory
  joins: Map<string, PendingJoin> };
```

Contracts L10, verbatim: `export async function resolveLocalOwnerName(env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): Promise<string>;`

Contracts L7, verbatim: "First helper start with no `owner.json`: `username = resolveLocalOwnerName(env)` (L10); `color = defaultHumanColor(LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID)` (`packages/contracts/src/m1/colors.ts:19-21`)."

### Invariants — `serve`

1. **Order** (a losing racer must not write anything): resolve paths/options → `ownerDefault = { v: 1, username: await resolveLocalOwnerName(env), color: defaultHumanColor(LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID), updatedAt: new Date(now()).toISOString() }` → `store = await openLocalStore({ root: helperPaths(env).root, ownerDefault, now, random })` (no writes, KI-130 invariant 3) → `adminToken = base64url(random(32))` → `server = createHelperServer(…)` → `listen()` → on success `await store.setOwner(store.owner())` (persists a bootstrapped `owner.json`; harmless when it existed) → `writeJsonAtomic(helperFile, { v: 1, pid: process.pid, port, origin, adminToken, version: KHALA_AGENT_VERSION, startedAt })`.
2. **`EADDRINUSE`**: `await store.close()`; `GET http://127.0.0.1:<port>/healthz` with a 500 ms timeout; `200` and `ok === true` → return `0` silently; else write `{"error":"port_in_use"}` to stderr and return `1`. Any other listen error → `{"error":"listen_failed"}` on stderr, `1`. A `StateError` at open → `{"error":"<StateError.code>"}` (e.g. `unsafe_state_dir`) on stderr, `1`.
3. **`HelperContext`** (built in `createContext(origin)`): `store`, `origin`, `now`, `random`, `version: KHALA_AGENT_VERSION`, `joins: new Map()`, plus:
   - `mintOpenToken(roomId?)`: token `base64url(random(32))`; keep `Map<sha256hex, { roomId?: string; expiresAt: number }>`; return `{ token, expiresAt: new Date(now() + LOCAL_LINK_TTL_MS).toISOString() }`.
   - `consumeOpenToken(token)`: hash, look up, **delete** (single use), `null` when unknown or `expiresAt <= now()`, else `{ roomId? }` (omit the key when absent).
   - `createOwnerSession(): string` — returns a fresh `base64url(random(32))` (43 chars) and adds it to the in-memory owner-session `Set`. Called by KI-134's `GET /open/<token>` route, which puts it in `set-cookie`.
   - `shutdown(): void` — schedules the stop trigger with `setTimeout(stop, 25)` (never synchronously: KI-134 calls it inside the `/api/local/shutdown` handler, and the `204` must be flushed before KI-131's `close()` destroys sockets).
   These two members are required by KI-134 (its "required L8 additions") but are not in L8 as written; they must be in KI-110's landed `HelperContext`. See stop conditions.
4. **Auth callbacks**: `authenticateCookie(v)` → the in-memory owner-session `Set` has `v`. `authenticateBearer(t)` → `timingSafeEqual(sha256(t), sha256(adminToken))` → `{ kind: 'owner', via: 'admin' }`; else `store.agentForToken(t)` → `{ kind: 'agent', userId, roomId }`; else `{ kind: 'none' }`.
5. **Stop triggers**: `options.signal` abort, `SIGTERM`, `SIGINT`, `onIdle`, `ctx.shutdown()`. Any of them → once: `await server.close()`, `await store.close()`, remove `helper.json` **only if** `readHelperFile(env)` still shows `pid === process.pid` and `port === <our port>`, remove the signal handlers, return `0`.
6. `serve` prints nothing on stdout. Its stdout/stderr are `helper.log` when started by `ensureHelper`; never write tokens, cookie values, paths with tokens or message bodies there.
7. `defaultWebDir()` resolves from `packages/agent/src/local/serve.ts` up four levels to the repo root, then `apps/web/dist-local/` (a runtime filesystem path, not an import; `check-boundaries` does not see it).

### Invariants — CLI

8. Output is exactly one line: `JSON.stringify(value) + '\n'` on stdout. Success → exit 0. Every failure → `{"error":"<code>"}` on stdout and exit 1. Nothing else on stdout.
9. Error codes the CLI emits: `invalid_arguments` (unknown command, missing or extra arguments), `not_found` (no channel with that exact name, or the helper answered 404), `ambiguous_channel`, `helper_unavailable` (`ensureHelper` failed, or a fetch to the helper threw), `unsafe_state_dir` / `storage_failed` (a `StateError` from `ensureHelper`), the helper's own `{"error":code}` for any other non-2xx answer, and `internal_error` for an unparsable answer.
10. **Channel argument resolution** (`link`, `open`, `delete`): `isLocalRoomId(arg)` → use it as is. Otherwise `GET /api/local/channels` and keep summaries whose `name === arg` exactly: 0 → `not_found`, more than 1 → `ambiguous_channel`, 1 → its `roomId`.
11. Every helper request carries `authorization: Bearer <adminToken>`; requests with a body carry `content-type: application/json`; no `Origin`, no cookie. URLs encode the room id with `encodeURIComponent`.
12. `create [name]`: name default `local-${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}` from the **local** date of `now()` (zero-padded). `POST /api/local/channels {name}` → print the `LocalChannelCreated` body unchanged.
13. `create` and `open` also do `GET <origin>/` (no auth); when it answers `503` with `{"error":"web_not_built"}`, write `khala: web app not built; run pnpm --filter @khala/web build:local` to **stderr** (stdout stays the single JSON object; exit code unchanged).
14. `status` never calls `ensureHelper`: `readHelperFile` → `null` → `{ running: false }`; else healthz (500 ms; `pid` must match) → unhealthy → `{ running: false }`; healthy → `GET /api/local/channels` → `{ running: true, origin, pid, version, channels: <count> }` (`version` from healthz).
15. `stop` never calls `ensureHelper`: no file or unhealthy → `{ stopped: false }`; else `POST /api/local/shutdown` → `204` → poll healthz every 100 ms for up to 2 s until it fails → `{ stopped: true }` (also `true` if it is still answering after 2 s, since the shutdown was accepted).
16. `serve` with any extra argument → `invalid_arguments`; otherwise return `await serve({ env })`. The default `main` for `serve` schedules `setImmediate(() => process.exit(code))` after `runHelper` resolves (copy `packages/agent/src/mcp/main.ts:106`), so stray handles can never keep a stopped helper alive.
17. The CLI never opens a browser and never imports `node:child_process` (spawning is KI-136's).
18. Terminology: no user-visible string in `cli.ts`/`serve.ts` uses "room" or "chat" (`scripts/check-terminology.mjs`); property keys such as `roomId` are fine.

### `bin/khala.mjs`

```js
} else if (cmd === 'local') {
  const url = new URL('../src/local/cli.ts', import.meta.url);
  if (!existsSync(url)) { console.log('{"error":"internal_error"}'); exitWith(1); }
  else {
    try {
      const code = await (await import(url.href)).default(rest);
      if (typeof code !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(code)) throw new Error('bad_exit');
      exitWith(code);
    } catch { console.log('{"error":"internal_error"}'); exitWith(1); }
  }
}
```

### Steps

1. **`serve.ts`** imports: `node:crypto` (`createHash`, `randomBytes`, `timingSafeEqual`), `node:fs/promises` (`unlink`), `node:path`, `node:url`; `writeJsonAtomic`, `StateError` from `../state`; `KHALA_AGENT_VERSION` from `../version`; `defaultHumanColor` from `@khala/contracts/m1/colors`; `LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID`, `LOCAL_LINK_TTL_MS`, `LOCAL_IDLE_EXIT_MS` from `@khala/contracts/m1/local`; `resolveLocalOwnerName` from `./identity`; `openLocalStore` from `./store`; `createHelperServer` from `./http`; `helperPaths`, `readHelperFile` from `./lifecycle`; the four route factories from `./routes/*`; types from `./types`.
2. Implement `runHelper` following invariants 1–6. Use one `let stop: () => void` created from a `new Promise<void>` that all triggers call; `process.once('SIGTERM', stop)`/`process.once('SIGINT', stop)` and `off` them in `finally` (pattern: `packages/agent/src/mcp/main.ts:95-103`).
3. **`cli.ts`**: `runLocalCommand(argv, deps)`:
   - `const [command, ...args] = argv`; arity table: `create` 0–1, `link` 1, `open` 0–1, `list` 0, `delete` 1, `status` 0, `stop` 0, `serve` 0.
   - `helper()` = `deps.ensureHelper(env)` mapped: `KhalaClientError` → `helper_unavailable`; `StateError` → its `code`.
   - `call(method, path, body?)` → `fetch(origin + path, …)`; a throw → `helper_unavailable`; `204` → `null`; `2xx` → parsed JSON; non-2xx → `{ error }` from the body when it is a string, else `internal_error`.
   - Throw a private `CliError(code)` from helpers and catch once at the top to print `{"error":code}`.
4. `main(argv)`: `runLocalCommand(argv)` with real deps (`ensureHelper`/`readHelperFile` from `./lifecycle`, `runHelper` from `./serve`, `globalThis.fetch`, `process.stdout.write`); for `serve` add the `setImmediate(process.exit)` from invariant 16.
5. Edit `bin/khala.mjs` and `src/bin.test.ts` as specified. In `bin.test.ts`'s `beforeEach`, also `mkdir(join(fixture, 'src/local'), { recursive: true })`.

## Test scenarios

### `packages/agent/src/local/cli.test.ts` (fake helper)

Fakes: `ensureHelper` resolving `{ origin: 'http://127.0.0.1:47830', adminToken: 'A'.repeat(43) }`; `fetch` routing on `method + url` and recording headers/bodies; `stdout`/`stderr` capture; `now` fixed at a local date of 2026-10-02.

1. `create refactor` → one POST `/api/local/channels` with `authorization: Bearer AAAA…`, body `{"name":"refactor"}`; stdout is exactly the 201 body + `\n`; exit 0.
2. `create` with no name → body name `local-2026-10-02`.
3. `create` when `GET /` answers `503 {"error":"web_not_built"}` → stdout unchanged JSON, stderr exactly `khala: web app not built; run pnpm --filter @khala/web build:local\n`, exit 0.
4. `link refactor` with two channels named `refactor` → `{"error":"ambiguous_channel"}`, exit 1, no POST made. One match → POST `/api/local/channels/%21c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw%3Alocal/links`. Zero → `not_found`.
5. `link !c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local` → no list request; POST to the encoded path.
6. `open` → POST `/api/local/open` with body `{}`; `open refactor` → body `{"roomId":"!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local"}`; stdout `{ openUrl, expiresAt }`. No module in `cli.ts` imports `node:child_process` (read the file text in the test and assert it does not contain `child_process`).
7. `list` → `{"channels":[…]}` (the `channels` array of the page, without `revision`).
8. `delete refactor` → DELETE `/api/local/channels/%21…%3Alocal` → `204` → `{"deleted":"!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local"}`; helper `404 {"error":"not_found"}` → `{"error":"not_found"}`, exit 1.
9. `status` with `readHelperFile` → `null` → `{"running":false}` and `ensureHelper` **not** called; with a file and healthy healthz (`pid` match) and 2 channels → `{"running":true,"origin":…,"pid":…,"version":"0.0.0","channels":2}`.
10. `stop` with no file → `{"stopped":false}`; with a healthy helper → POST `/api/local/shutdown` then healthz fails → `{"stopped":true}`; `ensureHelper` never called.
11. `ensureHelper` rejecting `new KhalaClientError('internal_error','helper_unavailable')` → `{"error":"helper_unavailable"}`, exit 1; a fetch throw → `helper_unavailable`.
12. Arity: `[]`, `['frobnicate']`, `['link']`, `['list','x']`, `['serve','--x']` → `{"error":"invalid_arguments"}`, exit 1.
13. Secret hygiene: across all scenarios, stdout and stderr never contain the admin token.

### `packages/agent/src/local/serve.test.ts` (real composition, in process)

Setup: `tmp = mkdtemp`, `env = { XDG_STATE_HOME: tmp, USER: 'kevin', HOME: tmp }`, `webDir = <tmp>/web` with `index.html`; `const ac = new AbortController(); const exit = runHelper({ env, port: 0, webDir, idleMs: 60_000, signal: ac.signal })`; wait (poll every 20 ms, ≤ 3 s) for `readHelperFile(env)`. `fromFile = async () => { const f = await readHelperFile(env); return { origin: f!.origin, adminToken: f!.adminToken }; }`.

14. **helper.json.** Valid `HelperFile`; `pid === process.pid`; `origin === 'http://127.0.0.1:' + port`; mode `0o600`; `owner.json` exists with `username: 'kevin'` and `color === defaultHumanColor('@khala_owner:local')`.
15. **Integration (AE1 shape).** `runLocalCommand(['create', 'refactor'], { env, ensureHelper: fromFile, stdout })` → parse: `isLocalRoomId(roomId)`, `name: 'refactor'`, `selfLink`/`shareLink` match `^http://127\.0\.0\.1:\d+/join/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$` and differ, `openUrl` matches `/open/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$`. `<tmp>/khala/local/channels/<roomKey>/log.jsonl` has exactly 2 lines: seq 1 `m.room.create` with name `refactor`, seq 2 owner `join` with `displayname: 'kevin'`. Then `list` → 1 channel; `link refactor` → a new share link; `status` (with `readHelperFile` real, `fetch` real) → `running: true`, `channels: 1`.
16. **Open link → cookie (P1).** `fetch(openUrl, { redirect: 'manual' })` → `302`, `set-cookie` starts with `khala_local_owner=` and contains `HttpOnly` and `SameSite=Strict`; `GET /api/local/profile` with that cookie → `200` with `username: 'kevin'`; the same `openUrl` again → not `302` to a channel (single use).
17. **Agent bearer cannot use owner routes (AE11).** Call `POST /api/agent/join` with the `selfLink` (`harness: 'claude', label: 'Claude'`), poll once for credentials, then `GET /api/local/channels` with `Bearer <agent accessToken>` → `403 {"error":"forbidden"}` (KI-134's owner gate); with the admin bearer → `200`.
18. **Stop via CLI.** `runLocalCommand(['stop'], { env, stdout })` (real `readHelperFile`, real `fetch`) → `{"stopped":true}`; `await exit` → `0`; `helper.json` no longer exists; `log.jsonl` still exists (persistence, AE12 counterpart).
19. **Second helper, same port.** With helper A running on port P, `runHelper({ env, port: P, webDir })` → resolves `0` quickly; `helper.json` still holds A's content; A still answers healthz.
20. **Port held by a stranger.** A plain `node:http` server on port Q answering `404` to everything → `runHelper({ env, port: Q, webDir, stderr })` → `1`, stderr `{"error":"port_in_use"}`; no `owner.json` or `helper.json` was written by it (assert `owner.json` absent in a fresh `tmp`).
21. **Idle.** `runHelper({ env, port: 0, webDir, idleMs: 100 })` → resolves `0` on its own within 2 s; `helper.json` removed.
22. **Signal.** `ac.abort()` → resolves `0`; `helper.json` removed.
23. **Restart keeps data (AE8).** Create a channel, stop, start again → `list` shows it with the same `roomId`; `helper.json` has a new `adminToken`.

### Spawned binary smoke (in `cli.test.ts`, pattern `packages/agent/src/mcp/main.test.ts:65`)

24. `spawn(process.execPath, ['bin/khala.mjs', 'local', 'status'], { env: { ...process.env, XDG_STATE_HOME: tmp } })` (cwd `packages/agent`) → exit 0, stdout `{"running":false}\n`, stderr empty. `['local', 'frobnicate']` → exit 1, stdout `{"error":"invalid_arguments"}\n`.

### `packages/agent/src/bin.test.ts`

25. Usage for `[]` and `['bogus']` is `usage: khala mcp | khala hook <name> | khala local <command> | khala --version\n`.
26. `['local']` with no `src/local/cli.ts` in the fixture → exit 1, stdout `{"error":"internal_error"}\n`; with a fixture `src/local/cli.ts` exporting `default async (argv) => argv.length` → `['local','a','b']` exits 2; a fixture that throws → exit 1, stdout `{"error":"internal_error"}\n`.

Mutation checks (each must fail a test, then revert): write `helper.json` or `owner.json` before `listen()` succeeds (scenarios 19 and 20 fail: 19 asserts A's `helper.json` is byte-identical afterwards, 20 asserts no `owner.json`); call `shutdown`'s stop synchronously (scenario 18: the CLI no longer receives `204`); let `status` call `ensureHelper` (scenario 9); print the web hint on stdout (scenario 3).

## Verification

```sh
pnpm --filter @khala/agent typecheck
pnpm --filter @khala/agent test -- src/local/cli.test.ts src/local/serve.test.ts src/bin.test.ts
pnpm --filter @khala/agent test
pnpm check:boundaries
node scripts/check-terminology.mjs
```

Manual (the worker records the output in the PR description):

```sh
XDG_STATE_HOME=$(mktemp -d) KHALA_LOCAL_PORT=47999 node packages/agent/bin/khala.mjs local create refactor
XDG_STATE_HOME=<same> KHALA_LOCAL_PORT=47999 node packages/agent/bin/khala.mjs local status
XDG_STATE_HOME=<same> KHALA_LOCAL_PORT=47999 node packages/agent/bin/khala.mjs local stop
```

## Acceptance

- [ ] `khala local create|link|open|list|delete|status|stop|serve` behave exactly as L12, one JSON object on stdout, exit 0/1.
- [ ] `serve` writes `helper.json` (0600) only after binding, persists `owner.json` after binding, exits 0 and removes its own `helper.json` on idle, signal and shutdown; a second helper on a healthy port exits 0 without writing; a foreign port holder yields `port_in_use`.
- [ ] Scenarios 1–26 pass; mutation checks tried and caught.
- [ ] `bin/khala.mjs` dispatches `local`; `bin.test.ts` updated and green.
- [ ] No new dependency; no token in argv, env, stdout, stderr or `helper.log`.

## Risks and stop conditions

- **Stop** if any of KI-122, KI-130, KI-131, KI-136 landed a signature different from the quotes above; adapt only where this ticket says "adapt" (route factory arguments).
- **Stop and report** if KI-110's landed `HelperContext` lacks `createOwnerSession(): string` and `shutdown(): void` (required by KI-134). Do not edit `types.ts` or the route modules yourself.
- **Stop** if `ownerRoutes()` (KI-134) does not include `/api/local/shutdown` and `POST /api/local/open` — the CLI depends on them.
- KI-130's `createChannel` appends the owner join and KI-134's create route appends it only when missing; scenario 15 asserts exactly 2 lines. If it sees 3, report it.
- `bin/khala.mjs` is also touched by nobody else in this build; if a later rebase shows a conflicting edit to the usage line, keep both commands in the usage string.
- Do not add a `--detach` flag, a service unit, or a browser launcher.

## Complexity rationale

2: pure composition and a small command table over already-specified modules; the risk is ordering (bind before any write) and wiring the in-memory context hooks, both covered by the in-process integration test.

Standing rule: do not raise human_required decisions for anything this ticket answers; do not add blockers.
